# isAdmin

<link-summary>Reports whether the current user is a Workspace administrator.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isAdmin() — Reports whether the current user is a Workspace administrator. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/admin</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isAdmin(): boolean;
```

The active user is looked up through the Admin SDK Directory service, which the script has to have enabled and be authorised for. Anything that goes wrong — the service missing, the lookup refused — is logged and answered as `false`, so the call is safe to make from a menu builder.

It is a question about the person running the script, not about a permission on a document.

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the active user is an administrator.

## Examples

### Gating a feature

```javascript
if (isAdmin()) {
  showAdminMenu();
}
```
